question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2019-01-01' AS mth, 1 AS month_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH, month_num + 1
    FROM months WHERE month_num < 12
),
start_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty AS starting_qty
    FROM inventory_totals
),
inv_model AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        m.mth,
        m.month_num,
        s.starting_qty AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS sales,
        pm.qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase,
        s.starting_qty - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS ending_inv,
        ABS(s.starting_qty - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) - pm.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM start_inv s
    JOIN months m ON m.month_num = 1
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON s.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id = b.product_id AND m.mth = b.mth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        m.mth,
        m.month_num,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase 
             ELSE im.ending_inv 
        END AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(b.qty, 0) AS sales,
        im.qty_minimum,
        im.qty_purchase,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inv,
        ABS(CASE WHEN im.ending_inv < im.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv + im.qty_purchase - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0)
        END - im.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inv_model im
    JOIN months m ON m.month_num = im.month_num + 1
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON im.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON im.product_id = b.product_id AND m.mth = b.mth
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff, mth) AS rn
    FROM inv_model
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id
